mapper.select: SELECT bid_at, has_ad, id FROM bid_log WHERE slot_code = #{slot} ORDER BY bid_at DESC, has_ad DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, 1

SELECT b.id, b.slot_code, b.has_ad, b.bid_at, b.request_id, b.cost_ms, b.pay_price FROM bid_log b JOIN (SELECT id FROM bid_log WHERE slot_code = #{slot} ORDER BY bid_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}) t ON t.id = b.id ORDER BY b.bid_at DESC
